name: @cas/dashboard
description: Editorial dashboard application (Next.js). Parallel Sprint 6 track: login and sessions, role-gated command center, review queue, incident explorer, evidence and anomaly views, draft preview and editor, and account administration. Speculative until Codex Desktop audits it; account persistence is paused pending the next migration number.

scripts.typecheck: next typegen && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json --noEmit
scripts.test:db: pnpm -w exec turbo run build --filter=@cas/dashboard^... && vitest run --config vitest.db.config.ts
